statement: The proportion of mothers using postpartum contraception differs between those who experienced SUID and those who did not.
rationale: This design compares the prevalence of postpartum contraceptive use among mothers with SUID cases to those in a representative sample from PRAMS. The data can support this comparison, though it has limitations due to differences in measurement timing and potential biases.
prior_art: None in the inputs; existing manuscripts focus on risk factors like bed sharing and maternal smoking but do not address postpartum contraception use.
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causality or incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator that includes both live births and infant deaths for the same period.
